title: A DEFINE COLUMN can be filtered in a query measure
query: MEASURE Sales[High Sales] = CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], Product[Price Band] = "High" )

source.quote: The COLUMN keyword introduces a table column ( DEFINE ) in a query (also known as query column).
source.supports: the query column is a column of the table for the query

source.quote: The expression can use any of the defined entities.
source.supports: a query measure can use a query column

derivation: Price Band is High for Bike (100) and Scooter (50). Their sales: Bike rows 1, 5, 7 = 100 + 200 + 100 = 400; Scooter none. Total 400.
